answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in lotus and nectar lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the terrace graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1627 impostors cost 1873 times the honest price and take 29 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
